attributes.name: primary button width
attributes.definition: Whether the primary form action button spans the full width of its form or sits at its natural/compact size.

values.definition: Button stretches to the full width of the form/container.
Button sized to its content or a fixed small size, not spanning the form.

attributes.name: primary button shape
attributes.definition: The corner/outline shape of the primary form submit button.

attributes.name: form input style
attributes.definition: Visual treatment of text input fields (fill and corner shape).

values.definition: White-filled fields with small or no radius.
Fields defined by border or transparent fill.

attributes.name: secondary link beneath submit
attributes.definition: Presence and treatment of a secondary text link placed below the primary submit button.

values.definition: A centered underlined link under the button.
No secondary link beneath the button.
